authorization: User: implementa isso. Implement the prior research priorities: BTC carry execution diagnostics, dated cash-and-carry and perpetual convergence. Public data, no accounts, orders, paid services, agents or production/automation changes.
governance: Two new BTC strategy streams, separate from the completed AR1-AR3 five-stream budget. No parameter searches or reopening of frozen funding_oi_hmm_v3, H1-H9, SMA200, or v6 observer. Cost scenarios are sensitivity checks, not independently selected rules. Keep all negative and zero-trade results. Software corrections require preserved prior output and an explicit record.
prior_information: Read prior adaptive 2024-2026 AR1-AR3 results and public literature. Before registration, capability probes checked quarterly archive object names, current exchangeInfo and available settlement timestamps. Delivery response bytes were saved, but delivery prices and strategy performance were not inspected. No claim of untouched historical sample.

period.future_rule: Historical performance ends at cutoff opening price. All later candle fields stripped from normalized data. Current execution snapshots are separately timestamped diagnostics, not backdated fills, performance confirmation or calibration of historical parameters.

capital.quantity_policy: Floor 25% of current equity / reference spot open to fixed 0.001 BTC. Equal net base quantity long spot and short linear USDT futures. No rebalance within a holding. Costs paid in USDT-equivalent in historical model; actual commission asset/lot history remains uncertified.

decision_timing: At execution hour t, signal uses only close of candle t-2h (available at t-1h), allowing one complete hour of latency. Entry liquidity is the median of 30 full UTC daily quote volumes ending at UTC day boundary of t minus one day. Both spot and selected futures require all 720 hours and median daily quote volume >=5m USDT. No current exchange filter or future outcome used for historical selection. Entry/exit reference is first trade in hour t, a non-synchronous OHLC proxy, never certified simultaneous execution.

streams.mechanism: Lock a positive dated futures premium against equal spot and carry to actual settlement.
streams.entry_schedule: Evaluate at 00:00 UTC daily while flat. Generate every quarterly last-Friday expiry from March 2024 through December 2026, 08:00 UTC; do not filter universe to current listings or contracts with known favorable outcomes. Among contracts with 30 to 120 days remaining and passing lagged liquidity, choose earliest expiry then symbol. Enter only if lagged futures/spot close minus 1 > 0.021. No fallback to another contract when the earliest eligible fails the price gate.
streams.threshold_rationale: 1.5 times 140 bps adverse full market round trip at equal reference prices. Actual per-leg costs remain charged on each actual reference notional; this is a fixed gate, not an assertion of exact costs.
streams.exit: Hold to exchange-published delivery time and price, sell spot at that hour open. Settlement price is outcome-only; never substitute spot for missing settlement. If expiry is after cutoff, close both at cutoff open and label truncated. No rollover netting: close spot on expiry and reopen only at a subsequent daily decision. Missing held price/mark/settlement makes whole economic result unknown; retain ledger and failure, never erase the allocation.

streams.mechanism: Capture contraction of perpetual minus spot price gap; signed funding is an additional cashflow, not the entry predictor.
streams.entry_schedule: Evaluate each hour while flat. Enter only when lagged perpetual/spot close minus 1 > 0.0075 and lagged liquidity passes. Long spot only; no reverse arbitrage or spot borrowing.
streams.threshold_rationale: 50 bps base round trip plus 25 bps buffer. Keep threshold fixed across cost scenarios even if adverse profitability fails.
streams.exit: Close at next execution hour when the lagged basis <= 5 bps, or exactly 168 hours after entry, or cutoff, whichever is first. Exit before considering entries and never reopen in the same hour. No minimum profit stop or selective extension. Signed funding at entry hour is excluded; funding strictly inside (entry,exit) included.

costs.accounting: Market fees and slippage additive on reference traded notional, each leg/side. Actual settlement charges futures settlement fee, no fictional market spread on settled future; spot still pays fee/slippage. Settlement fee tiers are declared research assumptions, not certified account fees. Residual accrues hourly from first entry through cutoff including later cash periods. Stress cuts only positive funding, retains all negative payments and adds 0.5% entry spot notional loss. Report unmeasured-cost breakeven, not tax/custody/conversion as zero. No external benchmark requirement.

margin: Hourly mark highs, separate USDT cash collateral, all prior funding and current-hour negative funding only; no credit for spot gains. Require collateral after short mark loss >1% maintenance +0.5% close reserve of mark notional. Repeat with every hourly high increased 30%. Deduct full current hour residual before testing. Report first breach and minimum surplus. Continue mechanical cashflows for diagnosis if breach, but attainable result becomes unknown; never invent liquidation fills. Missing held marks also makes result unknown.
data: Public Binance REST hourly spot/perpetual bars; Binance Vision monthly expired quarterly trade and markPriceKlines with CHECKSUM; REST current-month tail when needed; public delivery-price endpoint. Existing BTC funding and mark archive may be reused only with original source hashes preserved. Preserve raw bytes, URL, actual known_at, response status, provider checksum and normalized hashes. Convert spot archive microseconds explicitly if used. Archive revisions and missing historical listing/fee rules remain limitations. Downloaded archival availability is not treated as historical real-time publication.
missing_data: No interpolation. Absent lagged inputs mean no entry with reason. Missing already-held valuation or settlement stops that stream with economic totals null, not zero. Archived quarterly prelisting gaps are retained, not filled. Settlement-hour future bar is not required for a settled position. Cutoff exposes only opening fields. Contract dates inferred from deterministic quarter calendar are checked against published settlement timestamps for matured selected contracts.
execution_diagnostic: After code and protocol freeze collect 12 paired public BTCUSDT spot/futures depth snapshots, nominal 5 seconds apart, with request start/end timestamps and 100 levels. Walk both sides for a target 1250 USDT spot purchase. Report spread/depth cost, acquisition skew/duration, common lot feasibility, commission-in-base alternative including hedge rounding/dust, and +30% mark margin stress. Snapshot freshness limit: each request <=2 seconds and midpoint timestamp skew <=500ms. Even passing does not establish simultaneous executable fills or account commissions. Read current filters only for this current diagnostic. No automatic orders or future scheduled collector.

attempt_budget.software_replays: Only corrections with old outputs retained and reason recorded

metrics: USDT ending equity and net profit, funding/basis/fees/overhead/mismatch decomposition
complete and cutoff-truncated hedges; entry and exit reasons; holding duration
hourly mark-close drawdown; calendar year contributions
gross exposure, active hours/weeks and all-cash weeks
minimum hourly margin surplus and +30% jump stress
weekly increments, top-five positive-week contribution and arithmetic exclusion
13-week circular block bootstrap, 5000 replicates, seed 20260908; descriptive only
unknown outcomes, missing inputs, source coverage and quote diagnostic limitations
decision: Zero entries = no opportunity under this registered rule. Candidate for separately frozen future observation only if all three cost scenarios positive, no held data gaps, nominal and +30% jump margin checks pass, >=5 completed non-truncated hedges and adverse descriptive bootstrap lower bound >0. Otherwise report conditional positive, fragile/negative or insufficient trades. None establishes independent validation or real profit. BTC execution diagnostic cannot authorize capital.
delivery: Code, tests, independent accounting audit, all ledgers and failures, source hashes, data and offline reproduction instructions. Preserve prior packages and create a distinct delivery. No new automation.
